item.title: Valentine's storm leaves Kingsville neighbors picking up the pieces
item.description: A storm that swept through Kingsville on Saturday left several residents dealing with significant property damage, forcing some to cancel Valentine's Day plans as they focused on cleanup efforts.

item.title: Corpus Christi considers raising beach parking permit fees from $12 to $20
item.description: City officials say the changes are necessary to keep up with rising costs for beach maintenance and services while ensuring beaches remain safe, clean and enjoyable for visitors.

item.title: Coastal Bend girls basketball Bi-District first round playoffs 2026 highlights, scores and schedule
item.description: 24 Coastal Bend high school girls basketball teams advanced to UIL Bi-District first round of playoffs. Check out Monday highlights from Bishop and Port Aransas, more scores and Tuesday's schedule.
